description: This file defines a custom exception class StaffNotFoundException, which extends an abstract exception class. It is used to indicate that a staff resource was not found, typically in response to invalid or non-existent staff identifiers.

classes.name: StaffNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a staff resource was not found, extends AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException.

methods.name: StaffNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a message indicating the staff with the given ID does not exist.

methods.name: StaffNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with an underlying cause, indicating staff with this ID does not exist.

methods.name: StaffNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructor with staff ID, calls superclass constructor with error message.

methods.name: StaffNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructor with staff ID and cause exception, calls superclass constructor with error message and cause.
